gaps: the seven modes of the fixture are compared in the picture with X_ITE 16.6.0 (silhouette overlap 0.98, mean abs diff 13 of 255 over the whole frame on Chromium 153 SwiftShader) and against the formula in our body; the CAMERASPACENORMAL and CAMERASPACEREFLECTIONVECTOR spheres differ visibly from X_ITE (X_ITE's own scaling of the camera-space range is not reproduced)

NOISE and NOISE-EYE are made from X_ITE's Perlin2.glsl (the same 2D value noise and cosine smoothing, parameter = scale xyz and translation xyz); the hash is fract(sin(..) * 43758.5453), which a GPU's float32 sin and JavaScript's double sin evaluate differently, so the picture shows the same kind of pattern, not the same pixels (the centre sphere of the fixture)
camera-space modes are recomputed on the CPU whenever the model-view matrix changes, not in a shader
